---
title: "Baseline DSA"
guide-section: "DSA & analysis"
---

Excel analogues: **`Baseline - external`** / **`Baseline - public`**, feeding
**Output 1-1** and **Output 1-2**.

Package: `lic_dsf.dsa`. Consumes Macro + Ext books from `load_core`; does not
recompute instrument PV schedules or apply Input 6 shocks (`lic_dsf.stress`).
Output DataFrames live in `lic_dsf.output`.

**Edit baseline inputs in Excel**, save, then `load_core`.

## What you get

| Piece | Excel role |
|-------|------------|
| `BaselineExternalBook` | External sustainability ratios |
| `BaselinePublicBook` | Public sustainability / Dom feeder ratios |
| `public_automatic_debt_dynamics` | Shared DUCIR / DUCGDPR / DUCER identities (also used by Realism 1) |
| `external_dsa_panel` (`lic_dsf.output`) | Output 1-1 headline six-row DataFrame (economist labels) |
| `public_dsa_panel` (`lic_dsf.output`) | Output 1-2 headline DataFrame (economist labels) |
| `output_11_table` (`lic_dsf.output`) | Full Output 1-1 geometry (index = Excel row) |
| `output_12_table` (`lic_dsf.output`) | Full Output 1-2 geometry (index = Excel row) |

## Load and compute

```python
from pathlib import Path

from lic_dsf.load import load_core
from lic_dsf.output import external_dsa_panel, output_11_table, public_dsa_panel

workbook = Path("data/lic-dsf-template-2025-08-12.xlsx")
macro, external, ext_base, pub_base = load_core(workbook)

external_dsa_panel(ext_base)
public_dsa_panel(pub_base)
output_11_table(ext_base)  # Excel row index; same years as the thin panel
```

Headline panels keep economist labels. The Excel-shaped tables are the
parity SUT (Output 1-1 / 1-2 numeric series vs live Excel).

## Panel rows (familiar indicators)

**External (`external_dsa_panel`)**

- PV of PPG external debt / GDP, / exports, / revenue
- PPG debt service / exports, / revenue
- External GFN (USD)

**Public (`public_dsa_panel`)**

- Public sector debt / GDP, PPG external debt / GDP
- PV of public debt / GDP, / revenue+grants
- Debt service / revenue+grants
- Public GFN / GDP

Book methods expose the same series individually (e.g.
`ext_base.pv_ppg_external_to_gdp()` ↔ Baseline R35 area).

## Excel cues

| Ratio | Baseline cue (approx.) |
|-------|-------------------------|
| PV PPG / GDP | R35 |
| PV PPG / exports | R36 |
| PPG DS / exports | R39 |
| PV public debt / GDP | R42 |
| Public GFN / GDP | R47 |
